newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish president lauds Deng as bold reformist.
newsitem.headline: Polish president lauds Deng as bold reformist.

text.p: Poland's ex-communist President Aleksander Kwasniewski praised Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping in a letter of condolence on Thursday as a statesman who had gazed boldly into the future.

Kwasniewski, who led the transformation of Poland's old communist party into a social democratic formation supporting market reforms after it lost power in 1989, wrote to Deng's chosen heir Jiang Zemin expressing sadness over his death.
"Deng Xiaoping was an innovative politician and a statesman who looked boldly into the future," said the letter, released by Kwasniewski's office to PAP news agency.

"The changes which China accomplished under his leadership will be lastingly entered on the pages of history. I bow my head in sadness, sharing the pain of the Deceased's family and of the entire Chinese nation," Kwasniewski wrote.
